newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge up as buyers prevail.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge up as buyers prevail.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged up in early Thursday morning trade as buyers prevailed over sellers, brokers said.
But market sentiment remained cautious over selling by arbitragers in light of a narrowing price gap between cash stocks and futures, they said.
After 23 minutes of trade, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average was up 48.01 points or 0.25 percent at 19,056.61. Nikkei September futures were up 20 points at 19,050.
Brokers said many participants were inclined to take a wait-and-see stance amid a lack of strong trading incentives.
